Title: Oliver Wyman - Data&Analytics - Team Leader - Milan
Description:
Oliver Wyman - Data & Analytics

Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, is a management consulting firm driven by deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.

Clients approach us with their most significant challenges, and we assemble teams of experts to address each facet of these complex issues. Together, we create breakthroughs that lead to remarkable impact.

Within Oliver Wyman, the Data and Analytics (DNA) division was established in 2017 and is operating across the entire world, with a focus on Europe. We are a dynamic and rapidly growing team of quantitative analytics specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across the firm to cover a global footprint, working across multiple industries including, but not limited to, Financial Services, Climate & Sustainability, Energy, Retail, and Transportation.

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and collaborative teams to drive innovation. Our team comes from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we embrace the unique skills and insights they bring to our work.

At Oliver Wyman and within DNA, we are proud of the values we uphold that guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

____

The Roles And Responsibilities

This position offers excellent career and growth opportunities for talented, highly motivated professionals with relevant prior experience in quantitatively intense areas, particularly though not exclusively within financial services.

Flexible working and market leading work life balance will be a priority. There will be opportunities to travel with a mix of around 50% of time spent on client site vs off site, though individual needs will be considered when staffing offsite vs onsite roles.

Competitive salary and benefits. Clear career path to partner level, with potentially steeper trajectory than in similar firms.

The role will focus on managing projects:


Team Leaders would typically work on one project at a time.
Project work typically involves developing hypotheses; managing data collection, model creation and analyses; conducting primary and secondary research; creatively tackling information limitations; and surfacing insights, overseeing the work of analysts
Using Partners and the internal network effectively to provide technical and senior-level steer to projects
Working in a team together with clients to complete project deliverables to high standard
Maintaining energy and positive work life balance of team
Coaching Oliver Wyman and client team members to develop their skills


Your Attributes And Experience


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline. Ideally Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science or, Engineering
Strong analysis, documentation, and communication skills
Experience in using advanced analytics and data manipulation software - R, Python, SAS, SQL, or SPSS.
Work effectively and collaboratively in a team.
Be independent and work under limited supervision respecting defined timelines.
Present effectively results, potential issues and implications.
Excellent command of Italian and English language (verbal and written)
Ability to manage a demanding work volume and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Ability to maintain and respect confidentiality
Willingness to travel regularly
At least 5 years of previous working experience in specialised consulting firms, top tier banking or financial institutions with content in data analytics, credit risk, financial modelling, machine learning techniques.


Why Join Us?

Expect a steep learning curve, as no two projects are ever the same. You’ll have the opportunity to travel internationally, gaining invaluable experiences and insights across different cultures and with access to the latest technologies, you’ll constantly expand your toolkit with each new endeavour.

You won’t be alone on this journey; various colleagues will guide and coach you throughout your career. You’ll have a dedicated buddy, a career adviser, and a talent manager to help you navigate your professional path. We also care deeply about sustainable work-life quality, providing you with the flexibility to balance your career aspirations with your personal life.

This role will empower you to embrace your curiosity and step out of your comfort zone. You will have the opportunity to work alongside genuine colleagues who measure success by the lasting impact we create together. If you’re excited by challenges and eager to make a meaningful impact, we look forward to welcoming you aboard!

How to Apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

Compensation Information

Job title: Team Leader (m/f/d)

Location: Milan, Italy

Contract type: Permanent contract (contratto a tempo indeterminato)

CCNL applied: CCNL Commercio (National Collective Bargaining Agreement of companies in the Services and Distribution Sectors)

Level / Classification: Dirigente

Remuneration

Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, and a market-leading benefits package described below.

The expected base salary remuneration range for these positions is between EUR 69.000 gross and EUR 105.000 gross per year (full-time equivalent).

This amount is expressed as a full-time equivalent. The above salary range has been determined on the basis of objective and gender-neutral criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Any final salaries may vary based on factors such as your unique blend of experience and skills, and our current organizational needs.

Variable Compensation And Benefits

Variable pay


Annual discretionary bonus under the terms of the applicable Company Policy (variable remuneration linked to individual and company performance)


Benefits (company-paid And Additional Benefits)


Supplementary insurance package paid by the Company, including health, life, accident insurance and permanent disability coverage
Company car or car allowance available for eligible roles under the Car Policy of Oliver Wyman Italia
Subscription to Wellhub paid by the Company
Corporate discounts: access to a range of partner discounts
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): confidential psychological, legal, and financial support services
Bonus for employee referral to fill an official vacancy
Employee Share Purchase Plan
Seniority milestone paid leave


We will also grant any relevant economic provisions provided by the National Collective Bargaining Agreement to successful candidates.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Title: Data Engineer | Machine Learning
Description:
Per azienda IT innovativa che opera nel campo della computer vision e dell’AI applicata al mondo fisico, facente parte di una holding strutturata, si ricerca un profilo di Data Engineer.




Attraverso tecnologie proprietarie e completamente privacy-compliant, sviluppano soluzioni in grado di analizzare flussi di persone e veicoli in spazi reali, trasformando il mondo fisico in dati digitali utilizzabili per il business.




Posizione

Siamo alla ricerca di un Data & Analytics Engineer con 2–4 anni di esperienza, che voglia crescere in un contesto tech ad alta complessità e diventare un punto di riferimento per l’analisi dei dati e l’evoluzione dell’infrastruttura data. Il/La candidato/a entrerà a far parte del team Tech R&D e collaborerà a stretto contatto con i team Operations e Product, contribuendo in modo concreto alla valorizzazione del dato lungo tutto il suo ciclo di vita: raccolta, validazione, modellazione, analisi e reporting.




Responsabilità

La risorsa avrà responsabilità su:

Estrazione, trasformazione e validazione di dati provenienti da database relazionali (MS SQL, PostgreSQL) e non relazionali (Cassandra)
Analisi di dataset complessi, con particolare attenzione a dati di mobilità e dati spazio-temporali
Produzione di insight ad alto valore aggiunto a partire dai dati raccolti
Preparazione di analisi e reportistica per clienti, traducendo i risultati in raccomandazioni operative chiare ed efficaci
Presentazione dei risultati ai clienti e agli stakeholder interni
Progettazione e sviluppo di algoritmi per l’identificazione di pattern, anomalie, dati mancanti e trend rilevanti
Supporto alla progettazione, sviluppo e gestione di pipeline dati ETL/ELT in Python e Databricks




Requisiti

- Must have:

Ottima conoscenza di Python e dei principali strumenti/librerie per data analysis e data engineering, come Pandas, PySpark
Familiarità con la programmazione orientata agli oggetti
Ottima conoscenza di database relazionali SQL-based
Esperienza con database non relazionali, preferibilmente Cassandra
Capacità di realizzare analisi e insight e capacità di presentarle, sia nella preparazione del materiale, sia nell'esposizione orale dei risultati a clienti e stakeholder interni




- Nice to have:

2–4 anni di esperienza in ambito data analytics e/o data engineering
Esperienza nella progettazione o manutenzione di pipeline dati ETL/ELT
Conoscenza di strumenti di data visualization, come Plotly o Seaborn
Esperienza nell’analisi di dati a forte componente spazio-temporale, come serie storiche, dati geolocalizzati o dati di mobilità
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata
Familiarità con ambienti cloud




Altre Informazioni

Sede: Milano, zona MM Precotto
Modalità di lavoro: ibrida
Range RAL: 35K-43K
Smart Working

Title: Data Governance and AI Expert
Description:
Il Gruppo Ansaldo Energia è uno dei leader mondiali della power generation. Il suo core business è la fornitura e il service di componenti e soluzioni tecnologiche per la produzione di energia con macchine rotanti. L’azienda progetta e realizza turbine e generatori e ne cura l’assistenza e il miglioramento continuo. Con sede a Genova, il Gruppo conta oltre 3.300 dipendenti e ha una forte presenza internazionale grazie alle sue oltre 30 sedi nel mondo. Ansaldo Energia è tra i protagonisti del percorso di transizione e decarbonizzazione della produzione di energia elettrica. La sua flotta di turbogas è già oggi pronta a bruciare idrogeno tra il 40 e il 70%, con l’obiettivo di raggiungere il 100% entro il 2030.

Posizione:

Stiamo cercando una risorsa che si occupi di governance dei dati, guidando e supervisionando il nostro quadro di governance dei dati all’interno dell’organizzazione IT. Il ruolo è fondamentale per garantire qualità, integrità, sicurezza e conformità dei dati in tutti i sistemi aziendali, comprese le piattaforme cloud e on-premise.

La figura lavorerà a stretto contatto con il reparto IT, gli stakeholder aziendali e i partner esterni per definire politiche, standard e processi relativi ai dati a supporto delle nostre iniziative di trasformazione digitale.

Principali responsabilità:

Allineamento tra business e tecnologia


Analizzare e formalizzare i requisiti di business, traducendoli in soluzioni tecniche
Valutare l’allineamento con l’architettura aziendale e la strategia digitale dell’azienda
Fungere da collegamento tra gli stakeholder aziendali, i team ICT e i partner esterni


Innovazione e tecnologie emergenti:


Individuare, valutare e realizzare prototipi di tecnologie emergenti (IA, GenIA, automazione, analisi avanzate)
Collaborare con fornitori di tecnologia e integratori di sistemi su iniziative PoC (Proof of Concept)
Supportare l’adozione di piattaforme di innovazione digitale (strumenti di automazione, servizi di IA)


Soluzioni per dati e IA


Gestione end-to-end delle pipeline di dati: pre-elaborazione, feature engineering, validazione
Progettazione e implementazione di modelli predittivi (regressione, classificazione, previsione)
Valutazione di soluzioni di IA/ML, tra cui:


Modelli di deep learning

Modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM)

Applicazioni di visione artificiale

Implementazione tecnica e DevOps


Utilizzo di piattaforme cloud (AWS, Azure) per implementazioni scalabili
Utilizzo di pratiche e strumenti DevOps moderni (Git, Docker)


Analisi economica e di impatto


Valutazione del rapporto costi-benefici e del ROI delle iniziative digitali
Valutazione dell’impatto operativo, della scalabilità e dei costi di manutenzione a lungo termine
Contributo all’elaborazione di business case per gli investimenti digitali


Requisiti:

Background accademico:


Laurea magistrale o dottorato in discipline tecnico-scientifiche, preferibilmente:
Informatica
Ingegneria (informatica, elettronica, biomedica)
Matematica
Fisica
Statistica


Technical skills:


Analisi predittiva (regressione, classificazione, forecasting)
Deep Learning
Intelligenza Artificiale (sistemi intelligenti, LLM, computer vision)
Esperienza in linguaggi di programmazione:
Python, R, SQL
Esperienza con ambienti di calcolo e gestione dati:
Copilot Studio, N8N, Git, Docker, cloud computing (AWS, Azure,Google)
Data preprocessing, feature engineering, gestione dataset complessi
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.


Soft Skills


Capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari
Buone doti comunicative
Curiosità intellettuale e orientamento all’innovazione
Attitudine alla sperimentazione scientifica e alla validazione dei modelli
Capacità di condurre analisi statistiche e interpretare risultati in modo critico


Altre informazioni:


Per la posizione in oggetto la retribuzione annua lorda in ingresso sarà non inferiore a € 42.000
Tipo di contratto: tempo indeterminato
CCNL industria metalmeccanica privata e alla installazione di impianti
Premio di risultato e trattamenti da contrattazione integrativa di 2° livello
Elementi complementari: mensa aziendale, previdenza complementare, assistenza sanitaria integrativa e welfare.
Flessibilità oraria


Il trattamento retributivo verrà determinato in base alla effettiva esperienza professionale ed alle competenze tecniche emerse in selezione.

Il presente annuncio rispetta gli obblighi di trasparenza retributiva previsti dalla Direttiva UE 2023/970 e dalla normativa nazionale di recepimento

Title: Principal Research Scientist - Frontier Industrial AI
Description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Position: Principal Research Scientist - Frontier Industrial AI

Location: Cambridge/ London, UK, All EMEA, (hybrid)

Organization: AVEVA CT AI Research

Role type: Individual contributor

The role

AVEVA’s frontier AI research team, as part of the Chief Technologist Organization, focuses on developing the next generation of industrial intelligence. We are looking for exceptional researchers who combine original thinking with the ability to turn ambitious ideas into working systems.

You will define and pursue high-impact research questions, build experimental prototypes, publish influential work, and create defensible intellectual property. Research may span industrial foundation models for time-series and multimodal data, simulation and world models, trustworthy decision-support agents and staged autonomy, and AI-native approaches to industrial data foundations, ontology learning, and evaluation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in uncertain problem spaces, works with high autonomy, and finds practical ways to move difficult initiatives forward.

What You Will Do


Define and lead ambitious research initiatives in frontier industrial AI.
Develop new models, algorithms, evaluation methods, and system architectures.
Build high-quality experimental systems and validated research prototypes.
Publish at leading AI and machine learning venues and contribute to AVEVA’s patent and IP portfolio.
Create benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation frameworks for industrial AI.
Partner with leading AI labs, universities, and technology organizations
Take research from initial hypothesis through prototype and validation
Help shape AVEVA’s longer-term AI research direction and technical strategy.


What We Are Looking For


A PhD or equivalent research experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or a related field.
Evidence of original research through strong publications, patents, open-source work, prototypes, or other meaningful technical contributions.
Strong hands-on ability in AI experimentation and software development.
Ability to independently identify important problems, formulate research hypotheses, and execute projects with limited structure.
Deep expertise in one or more areas such as foundation models, multimodal learning, time-series modeling, generative models, reinforcement learning, agentic systems, simulation, world models, representation learning, or AI evaluation.
Strong scientific judgment and the ability to design rigorous experiments and communicate results clearly.
High agency, intellectual curiosity, and a constructive problem-solving mindset.
Ability to collaborate across research, engineering, product, and teams.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with industrial, manufacturing, energy, infrastructure, engineering, or scientific data.
Recent publications at leading machine learning, AI, data mining, robotics, or systems venues.
Experience developing models at scale or building complex research systems.
Experience with simulation environments, digital twins, multimodal data, or industrial time series.
A track record of initiating and advancing research projects with limited supervision.
Exceptional recent PhD graduates with a strong research record are encouraged to apply.


UK Benefits include:

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Title: Junior - Artificial Intelligence & Data
Description:
Junior – Artificial Intelligence and Data

Stiamo cercando una figura junior da inserire nel team di Artificial Intelligence and Data di Deloitte Consulting nella sede di Roma/Milano, che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

Nel Team di Artificial Intelligence & Data avrai l’occasione di aiutare, in ambito Analytics, le aziende a valorizzare i dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee trasformandoli in informazioni accurate e immediatamente utilizzabili, elementi indispensabili per quelle aziende che vogliono fare decision-making fact-driven. La Offering Artificial Intelligence & Data è pertanto l’opzione best in class nell’individuazione, progettazione e implementazione di soluzioni di Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Big Data Management, con un approccio agnostico dal punto di vista tecnologico.

Your Role

La risorsa Junior sarà inserita in un team di lavoro, affiancando colleghi senior e occupandosi di:


Interpretare proattivamente i bisogni del cliente, individuando metodologie e approcci coerenti
Sviluppare iniziative e soluzioni in modo indipendente, raccogliendo ed analizzando dati a supporto dell’elaborazione di soluzioni per i clienti
Elaborare teaser e presentazioni per supportare il top management
Individuare potenziali rischi e criticità e condividerli tempestivamente con il resto del team
Collaborare efficacemente in team eterogenei ed internazionali


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per la posizione di Analyst è compresa tra EUR 26.500 e EUR 31.000 lordi annui.

In caso di stage, è prevista un’indennità di tirocinio.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Brillante percorso accademico con laurea specialistica in materie STEM
Familiarità con la modellazione e linguaggio di interrogazione dei data base; conoscenza di uno o più linguaggi di accesso al dato e programmazione (Python, R, Java, SQL); ottima conoscenza degli applicativi MS Word, MS Excel e MS Power Point; nozioni accademiche di modelli statistici per l’analisi dei dati
Forte propensione/interesse per le nuove tecnologie e per l’informatica
Elevata attitudine a lavorare sia autonomamente che in team, capacità analitiche e di problem solving, gestione dello stress, flessibilità, precisione e uno spiccato orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; disponibilità a lavorare in trasferta, anche all’estero


To Make An Impact That Matters

Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone.

In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformation, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WordImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo.

Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che – in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti – hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Title: Air quality modeler
Description:
Who are we?

SUEZ is a world leader in smart and sustainable resource management, and our Air & Climate unit provides consulting services and develop and deploy digital solutions that address the key environmental needs of our customers.

ARIANET, the Air & Climate unit in Italy, delivers studies, develops, designs, installs and manages cutting-edge solutions related to air quality management: diagnostic, real-time monitoring, forecast and scenario studies, for a proven customer base of industries, public and para-public entities.

To provide the best environmental solutions for our customers, we are strengthening our applied modeling team which performs studies and develops and manage simulation systems in industrial and urban areas.

In this context, we are looking for an:




Air quality modeler

Your mission

You will join the ARIANET team, and you will be involved in atmospheric modelling, concerning mainly dispersion, chemical transformation and ground deposition of pollutants at regional and urban scales.

You will mainly use a simulation system including meteorological and emission models and based on FARM (Flexible Air Quality Regional Model) chemical-transport model, developed by ARIANET in collaboration with national and international research centers and with a significant user base.

You will contribute to the multiple applications of the system, typically: operational forecast of ambient air quality, yearly air quality assessments, reconstruction of past events, estimation of sources contributions, scenario studies in support of policy planning and impact assessment studies. These activities will also include drafting the relevant technical reports and presenting the results to clients, mostly public but also private.

You will progressively participate in the development of the models’ new features, documenting them.

You will also be able to actively participate in research activities carried out within European projects and to contribute to the drafting of scientific publications.




Your profile

You are the one if you:

have a master's degree in physics, engineering, environmental sciences, or related disciplines
possess basic knowledge of atmospheric physics and/or meteorology, acquired through university courses or documented post-graduate experience
have 2-4 years’ work experience in the field of atmospheric modelling
have a good command of Unix/Linux environments and of Fortran or Python programming languages
have good knowledge of the English language and good writing skills
have a strong motivation and interest in actively working in the environmental field
have good analytical and communication skills
can work independently while coordinating within a team







Following proven expertise and skills are a strong plus:

PhD in meteorology, atmospheric physics or chemistry, natural sciences, environmental engineering
experience with numerical modeling and scientific programming
high-performance computing environments, parallelization and optimization of computational codes
use of machine-learning in support of quantitative analyses and modelling in environmental field
use of GIS for environmental applications
CFD modelling




Conditions

Full-time job.

Place of work: Milano.

Salary: 32-38 k€ yearly gross (excluding bonus), commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate.










SUEZ encourages and values diversity in gender, ethnicity, generation, culture, health, physical condition, sexual orientation, etc.

Title: Junior - Credit Risk Modelling| Milan
Description:
Junior – Credit Risk Modelling| Milan

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions. When you join the Financial Risk team in Milan , you are going to work on Credit Risk Modelling projects, for top-tier clients in the Financial Services sector.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:


developing models for the quantification of the main credit risk parameters (PD, LGD and EAD) for management and regulatory purposes, in line with Basel regulations;
assisting clients with stress test;
contributing to the inclusion of ESG topics in risk measurement;
measurement of financial instruments (fixed income, securitisation and derivatives);
implementing pricing models for complex financial instruments (e.g., CLN, ABS, securitisation and CMS);
restructuring of derivative portfolios and development of the related financial models.


Skills

Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity if you have:


a specialist degree (graduate or nearing completion) in business, statistics, engineering, mathematics or any other quantitative faculty;
knowledge of programming software and languages (Python, SAS, R, Matlab and Stata);
excellent knowledge of Italian and English, preferably with study and/or work experience abroad;
excellent problem-solving skills and an innate ability to take initiative;
good interpersonal and teamwork skills.


Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG


An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity.
A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork.
Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programmes to stay current.
International mindset and innovative projects.
Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being.


Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a gross annual salary of €29,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our values and commitment

Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential.

As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125, relating to gender equality” . Within our Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - you will find summarised all the actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.

Join us!

Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) no. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - “GDPR”), as amended. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy .

Title: Deep AI native software engineer
Description:
YOU ARE

As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and DevOps & MLOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

THE WORK



Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions

Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems; design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps

Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC

Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites

Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production

Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools

Justify the value of model approaches in business problems

Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production



EDUCATION





Bachelor's Degree or equivalent



Basic (required) Qualification



Proven experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.

Experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming

Hands-on experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks

Experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.



Preferred Qualification



Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..

Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.

Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL

Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment

Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams

Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation

MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)



Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the Metalmeccanico National Collective Bargaining Agreement applies, with one of the following pay grades and corresponding gross annual salary range:

B2- €32,000 - €50,500

B3- €36,000 - €65,800

Title: DATA SCIENTIST
Description:
At Ayesa Digital, we grow with you.




Every professional in our company is essential. Thanks to their talent, we continue to expand: today, we are a global team of more than 11,000 people working toward a shared mission.




Ayesa Digital is currently participating in high-impact European Union projects designed to address major European challenges and drive science and innovation. These strategic technological initiatives stand out for their international scope and strong commitment to socially oriented results.




We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join an international and multicultural environment supporting scientific and policy-oriented projects related to the European forest-based sector. The successful candidate will contribute to the collection, management, analysis, and visualization of complex datasets, while developing analytical workflows, databases, and data-driven solutions that support strategic decision-making and scientific research.

This role requires a strong background in data science, GIS technologies, forest-based sector data analysis, and quantitative modelling, combined with excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.




Key Responsibilities




Analyse, validate, and cross-compare European, international, national, regional, and local datasets related to wood resources and wood-based products.
Design, develop, and maintain analytical databases supporting forest-based sector research and assessments.
Collect, clean, structure, and prepare data from heterogeneous sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Develop and maintain annual Wood Resource Balance Sheets at EU and Member State level.
Create and maintain static and web-based Sankey diagrams representing woody biomass flows, including automation scripts and update processes.
Perform statistical and quantitative analyses to support scientific studies and policy-related initiatives.
Produce data visualisations, graphs, charts, infographics, and other communication materials to present analytical findings.
Develop and maintain software tools and reproducible analytical workflows supporting scientific projects.
Collaborate with external stakeholders, including industry representatives, academic institutions, and SMEs, to collect data and define analytical requirements.
Prepare technical documentation, reports, training materials, workshop content, and contributions to scientific publications.
Present methodologies, results, and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams in a multilingual and international environment.




What We Are Looking For (Requirements):




Required Qualifications:

University degree corresponding to EQF Level 7 (Master's degree or equivalent).
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in IT and data-related roles.
Very good command of English and Italian (minimum B2 level or equivalent), both written and spoken.




Technical Expertise:

Minimum 5 years of experience with Python.
Minimum 5 years of experience with PostgreSQL/PostGIS.
Minimum 10 years of experience working with GIS technologies and tools.
Minimum 5 years of experience using e!Sankey.
Minimum 5 years of experience using MATLAB or Octave.
Strong knowledge of ArcGIS, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, and e!Sankey.
Extensive experience managing, cleaning, and structuring forest-based sector datasets.
Experience working with woody biomass supply and demand flows and wood processing industry technical coefficients.
Knowledge of programming languages commonly used in data science, such as Python, R, and SQL.
Experience designing and implementing data-driven analytical solutions.
Knowledge of data preparation, transformation, and reproducible dataset creation.
Experience with analytical data storage and querying technologies.
Strong data visualisation capabilities and experience communicating analytical insights.
Knowledge of version control and software development best practices, including Git.
Experience with Material Flow Analysis methodologies and related visualisation tools




What We Offer:

Prestigious projects within European institutions.
International, innovative, and multicultural environments.
Compensation between 85-90% rate.
Continuous support from a team of experts in EU projects.




If you are ambitious, enthusiastic, and seeking a new professional challenge in international projects with real-world impact, this is the place for you!

Title: Data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: Associate Consultant / Consultant in Data Science - AI Engineering
Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital.



Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility.



We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.



With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.





Descrizione del lavoro



Sia Partners ricerca un Associate Consultant / Consultant - Data Scientist / AI Engineer da inserire in progetti in Italia o all’estero di trasformazione digitale all'interno della Business Line globale di Artificial Intelligence e Data Science.



In Sia Partners il team di AI&DS non solo sviluppa e applica le proprie competenze in ambito Artificial Intelligence e Machine Learning, ma si occupa anche di comprendere fenomeni legati al Business dei nostri Clienti per indirizzarli verso progetti complessi di trasformazione digitali quali journey to cloud, sistemi di computazione avanzata e architetture complesse.



Il nostro obiettivo è quello di estrarre informazioni dalla complessità per permettere ai nostri Clienti di prendere decisioni strategiche.



La persona prescelta si occuperà di:



Sviluppare soluzioni di Artificial Intelligence all’interno dei progetti per i Clienti di riferimento
Comprendere le principali tecnologie a supporto dei progetti di trasformazione digitale
Guidare i Clienti nella comprensione dei rischi/opportunità dei progetti di trasformazione, identificando gli strumenti più adatti per disegnare architetture target
Utilizzare la propria esperienza tecnica in realtà cliente/consulenziali per contribuire alla generazione di insight di business utili per il decision-making

Oltre alle progettualità, alla risorsa inserite sarà richiesto un contributo sulle attività di ricerca e di sviluppo interne, ideazione di nuove soluzioni, casi d'uso ed attività di business development.





Qualifiche



I requisiti indispensabili per entrare a far parte del nostro team sono:



Laurea Specialistica in discipline STEM
prima esperienza in ruoli e/o funzioni di data science e AI
Conoscenza dei principali algoritmi ML e GenAI e delle principali tecnologie per supportare processi di trasformazione
Conoscenza ed esperienza nell’utilizzo di uno o più dei seguenti linguaggi: Python (obbligatorio), R, Matlab, Java
Conoscenza di almeno un servizio AI cloud based tra SageMaker, VertexAI e AzureML
Conoscenza di database strutturati e non strutturati (MySQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, ..)
Esperienza con strumenti di version control (es. Git)
Conoscenza professionale della lingua inglese

Soft Skills:



Spiccate doti comunicative per presentare risultati sia ad un audience tecnico che non
Spiccate doti interpersonali che consentano alla risorsa di lavorare in team e collaborare con i colleghi degli uffici internazionali
Adattabilità e flessibilità
Curiosità


Informazioni aggiuntive



Lavorando in Sia Partners troverai:



Un percorso di carriera dinamico e meritocratico, basato sulle performance;
Un ambiente di lavoro realmente internazionale, dove collaborerai con i data hub degli altri uffici dislocati su scala globale all’interno di Team multidisciplinari.
Una continua crescita e un forte spirito imprenditoriale;
Un rapporto diretto con il top management interno e dei nostri clienti;
Un luogo che abbraccia la concezione di lavoro flessibile e fa propri valori come la fiducia, l’autonomia e il rispetto tra le persone.
Un ambiente dove la diversità e l'inclusività sono il fulcro di ciò che siamo e di come lavoriamo.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.



Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Title: Pricing Actuary/Data Analyst
Description:
Job Purpose/Role

The candidate would be required to provide support to the Non Motor Actuarial Office across the full spectrum of Pricing analysis.

The Individual's Key Responsibilities Are Listed Below


Support the data ingestion and data transformation procedures
Data exploration, transformation and cleaning procedures
Structuring data science solutions to achieve a given set of business objectives
Build and prototype analysis and Machine Learning models and support their implementation and deployment in the systems of the company
Model customer’s behavior based on market and competitor’s analysis
Implement and enhance dashboards and business intelligence tools to support risk analysis and portfolio management
Implementation of Radar Base Projects for Impact Analysis/Scenario Testing
Implementation of the tariff (both Technical and Commercial), discount, UW rules, renewal process in Radar Live in accordance with technical specification provided by Pricing Actuaries, Product Development and Anti-Fraud people
Doing Research and Development to find new technical solutions


Key Requirements/Skills/Experience


PhD or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (i.e. computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics or engineering)
2-3 years working experience in a similar role
Good hands-on knowledge of programming languages (e.g. Python, SAS or R)
Experience with Pandas or SQL for data manipulation and analysis
Familiarity with machine learning techniques like gradient boosting machines and linear models
Passion and ability for data exploration, analysis and modelling in order to design and develop systems to support strategic business decisions
Preferably knowledge of the Tower Watson Suite: Emblem, Radar
Fluent in Italian and English
Ability to work independently as well as engage and interact with different stakeholders

Title: Oliver Wyman – Data & Analytics - Senior Analyst - Italy
Description:
Who We Are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consultancy working across all areas of industry, financial services, government, and non-profit organizations. Clients approach us with their most significant challenges, and we assemble teams of experts to address each facet of these complex issues. Together, we create breakthroughs that lead to remarkable impact.

Within Oliver Wyman, the Data and Analytics (DNA) division was established in 2017 and is operating across the entire world, with a focus on Europe. We are a dynamic and rapidly growing team of quantitative analytics specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across the firm to cover a global footprint, working across multiple industries including, but not limited to, Financial Services, Climate & Sustainability, Energy, Retail, and Transportation.

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and collaborative teams to drive innovation. Our team comes from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we embrace the unique skills and insights they bring to our work. At Oliver Wyman and within DNA, we are proud of the values we uphold that guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What Will You Do

As a member of Oliver Wyman’s Data & Analytics team, you will collaborate with colleagues and clients at all levels from your very first day, helping clients solve their most pressing challenges. Our DNA team is committed to developing tailored solutions for clients around the globe, including designing potential solutions for analytical challenges, implementing various prototypes while also assessing their effectiveness, and engaging in discussions with clients and colleagues to share ideas. Your contributions will be invaluable to delivering impactful results for our clients.

Notable projects include:


Developing an NLP-based machine learning toolkit to predict credit rating downgrades using news articles – click here for more information
Modelling portfolio decarbonization strategies leveraging advanced analytics techniques for large European banks
Optimizing and developing a promotional program using data from historical promotions for an Asian health & beauty chain by deploying a promotion analytics toolkit
Validating a customer-facing GenAI chatbot for an American bank
Developing probability of default and loss models in Python for European and UK-based banks
Identifying supply chain risks by combining multiple live data feeds, and developing and applying a bespoke AI based risk methodology – click here for more information
Developing a next best action model to reduce customer churn for a global telecom company


Why Join Us?

Expect a steep learning curve, as no two projects are ever the same. You’ll have the opportunity to travel internationally, gaining invaluable experiences and insights across different cultures and with access to the latest technologies, you’ll constantly expand your toolkit with each new endeavor.

You won’t be alone on this journey; various colleagues will guide and coach you throughout your career. You’ll have a dedicated buddy, a career adviser, and a talent manager to help you navigate your professional path. We also care deeply about sustainable work-life quality, providing you with the flexibility to balance your career aspirations with your personal life.

This role will empower you to embrace your curiosity and step out of your comfort zone. You will have the opportunity to work alongside genuine colleagues who measure success by the lasting impact we create together. If you’re excited by challenges and eager to make a meaningful impact, we look forward to welcoming you aboard!

Who Can Apply?


Bachelor's, Master’s, or PhD in a quantitative discipline from a top academic program (Data Science, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)
Data-driven mindset and proficiency with numbers, paired with the ability to explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner to clients and colleagues
Ideally, programming skills in Python or R, but more importantly, an eagerness to continuously extend your knowledge of technologies
Strong commitment to teamwork and resilience in a creative and constantly changing environment
Excellent command of the English and Italian language (verbal and written)
Interest and experience in financial services and risk management is a plus
At least 2 years of previous working experience in specialised consulting firms, top tier banking or financial institutions


How to Apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

What to expect during the interviews process?

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case and technical interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business.

If you want to learn more about consulting interviews and start your preparation, please visit our careers page: https://www.oliverwyman.com/careers/entry-level/interview-preparation.html

Compensation Information

Job title: Senior Analyst (m/f/d)

Location: Milan, Italy

Contract type: Permanent contract (contratto a tempo indeterminato)

CCNL applied: CCNL Commercio (National Collective Bargaining Agreement of companies in the Services and Distribution Sectors)

Level / Classification: Impiegato, Level 1

Remuneration

Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, and a market-leading benefits package described below.

The expected base salary remuneration range for this position is between EUR 43.000 gross and EUR 52.000 gross per year (full-time equivalent).

This amount is expressed as a full-time equivalent. The above base salary range has been determined on the basis of objective and gender-neutral criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Any final offer salaries may vary based on factors such as your unique blend of experience and skills, and our current organizational needs.

Variable Compensation And Benefits

Variable pay


Annual discretionary bonus under the terms of the applicable Company Policy (variable remuneration linked to individual and company performance)


Benefits (company-paid And Additional Benefits)


Supplementary insurance package paid by the Company, including health, life, accident insurance and permanent disability coverage
Company car or car allowance available for eligible roles under the Car Policy of Oliver Wyman Italia
Subscription to Wellhub paid by the Company
Corporate discounts: access to a range of partner discounts
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): confidential psychological, legal, and financial support services
Bonus for employee referral to fill an official vacancy
Employee Share Purchase Plan
Seniority milestone paid leave


We will also grant any relevant economic provisions provided by the National Collective Bargaining Agreement to successful candidates.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. Together, we create breakthroughs that lead to remarkable impact.

We are a dynamic and rapidly growing team of quantitative analytics specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across the firm to cover a global footprint, working across multiple industries including, but not limited to, Financial Services, Climate & Sustainability, Energy, Retail, and Transportation.

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and collaborative teams to drive innovation. Our team comes from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we embrace the unique skills and insights they bring to our work. At Oliver Wyman and within DNA, we are proud of the values we uphold that guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What Will You Do

As a member of Oliver Wyman’s Data & Analytics team, you will collaborate with colleagues and clients at all levels from your very first day, helping clients solve their most pressing challenges. Our DNA team is committed to developing tailored solutions for clients around the globe, including designing potential solutions for analytical challenges, implementing various prototypes while also assessing their effectiveness, and engaging in discussions with clients and colleagues to share ideas. Your contributions will be invaluable to delivering impactful results for our clients.

Notable projects include:

  • Developing an NLP-based machine learning toolkit to predict credit rating downgrades using news articles – click here for more information
  • Modelling portfolio decarbonization strategies leveraging advanced analytics techniques for large European banks
  • Optimizing and developing a promotional program using data from historical promotions for an Asian health & beauty chain by deploying a promotion analytics toolkit
  • Validating a customer-facing GenAI chatbot for an American bank
  • Developing probability of default and loss models in Python for European and UK-based banks
  • Identifying supply chain risks by combining multiple live data feeds, and developing and applying a bespoke AI based risk methodology – click here for more information
  • Developing a next best action model to reduce customer churn for a global telecom company

Why Join Us?

Expect a steep learning curve, as no two projects are ever the same. You’ll have the opportunity to travel internationally, gaining invaluable experiences and insights across different cultures and with access to the latest technologies, you’ll constantly expand your toolkit with each new endeavor.

You won’t be alone on this journey; various colleagues will guide and coach you throughout your career. You’ll have a dedicated buddy, a career adviser, and a talent manager to help you navigate your professional path. We also care deeply about sustainable work-life quality, providing you with the flexibility to balance your career aspirations with your personal life.

This role will empower you to embrace your curiosity and step out of your comfort zone. You will have the opportunity to work alongside genuine colleagues who measure success by the lasting impact we create together.   • Bachelor's, Master’s, or PhD in a quantitative discipline from a top academic program (Data Science, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)

  • Strong commitment to teamwork and resilience in a creative and constantly changing environment

  • Interest and experience in financial services and risk management is a plus
  • At least 2 years of previous working experience in specialised consulting firms, top tier banking or financial institutions

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

Title: AI & Data Science Engineer
Description:
Job Description

DXC Technology is looking for a Data Scientist to support AI and Generative AI projects, contributing to practical solutions and improving business processes through ML models, NLP and intelligent automation, within the Data & AI team based in Milan.

Key Responsibilities


Contribute to the design and implementation of AI solutions, including machine learning models, NLP, and computer vision applications
Collaborate with senior team members to understand client requirements and translate them into practical AI solutions
Support the direct relationship with clients/stakeholders for requirements gathering and solution validation
Support pre-sales activities, including preparing technical materials and contributing to client presentations
Stay up to date on AI trends and emerging technologies, applying knowledge to support solution development
Contribute to maintaining best practices and methodologies within the AI & Data Science team
Take part in AI solution projects, gaining hands-on experience in real client environments and progressively growing in autonomy.


Requirements


Proven experience in Gen AI projects.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions, including design and implementation.
Deep expertise in core Generative AI technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, Observability, and AI Guardrails.
Extensive experience with enterprise-grade GenAI development frameworks and platforms, including LangChain, LangGraph, LiteLLM, and Langfuse.
Proven experience in addressing AI governance, GDPR, and EU AI Act compliance requirements throughout the AI solution lifecycle.
Good knowledge of machine learning frameworks and libraries (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.)
Strong proficiency in AI-powered software development and code generation tools.
Extensive experience with enterprise software delivery practices and platforms, including source code management, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment frameworks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication skills and strong ability to work in a collaborative team.
Growing autonomy in managing assigned tasks and deliverables.
Ability to organize project activities by identifying priorities and ensuring deadlines are met


Nice to Have


Previous involvement in presales or solution support tasks


Location: Milan, with smart working possibility

Why Join Us

Offer Package

The position offers a gross annual base salary starting from €48.000

Compensation is determined in line with the applicable collective labor agreement (CBA: Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per l'industria metalmeccanica e della installazione di impianti) and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including responsibility, experience and skills.

Meal vouchers

Smart Working Agreement
Employee Discounts Program

Title: Experienced – Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Stiamo cercando una figura Senior Consultant da inserire nel team Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms per le sedi di Roma e Milano che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

L’area Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms è un’area di frontiera nell’utilizzo di tecnologie avanzate e si occupa di fornire servizi di Digital Transformation con l’obiettivo di supportare la digitalizzazione dei processi di business delle principali multinazionali clienti. Le attività prevedono l’utilizzo di strumenti di Generative AI, AI e Data Analytics, integrati all’interno di un ecosistema applicativo e infrastrutturale all’avanguardia (SOTA). Per questo, sfruttiamo i principali servizi offerti dai maggiori player del settore Cloud, oltre a soluzioni di deployment locali on-premise.

Your Role

La risorsa Experienced verrà inserita in un team di lavoro e si occuperà di:


Leadership Tecnologica: Assumere il ruolo di Team Leader, supervisionando e coordinando un team tecnico di sviluppo o consulenti junior con diverse expertise
Progettazione e Analisi Soluzioni AI & GenAI: Analizzare e progettare soluzioni GenAI, AI complesse, sia applicative che di integrazione con diversi sistemi
Gestione del Problem Solving: Affrontare e risolvere autonomamente problematiche tecniche articolate, mantenendo efficienza e precisione anche sotto pressione;
Collaborazione Internazionale: Operare all'interno di team numerosi e diversificati, con la possibilità di interagire su scala internazionale.


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 33.000 e EUR 37.500 lordi annui per il grade Consultant, e tra EUR 40.000 e EUR 49.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Laurea in materie STEM;
Esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di progetti di Data Science: raccolta requisiti, progettazione, sviluppo e test di soluzioni AI e GenAI. In particolare è richiesta esperienza di almeno 5 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di AI/ML e 2 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di GenAI
Conoscenza dei principali foundation model (llama, gpt, sonnet etc.) e loro applicazione a seconda della specificità del progetto.
Esperienza pregressa nello sviluppo di applicazioni di Generative AI (langchain, llamaindex, ecc.) con sviluppo e rilascio in produzione di soluzioni RAG sia in modalità chatbot che non
Ottima conoscenza di Python e delle librerie per manipolazione dati e sviluppo modelli;
Esperienza con strumenti di containerizzazione (e.g. docker) e strumenti di versioning del codice (e.g. GIT)
Conoscenza di strumenti e linguaggi per la manipolazione dei dati: SQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, Spark, ecc.
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese;
Flessibilità, disponibilità a viaggiare.


To Make An Impact That Matters

Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone.

In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformantion, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo.

Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che - in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti - hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Creiamo, lanciamo e scaliamo prodotti B2C e B2B attraverso il performance marketing, e ora vogliamo alzare l'asticella su come usiamo dati e automazione per prendere decisioni. Non cerchiamo qualcuno che si limiti a costruire dashboard. Cerchiamo una persona che gestisca il dato end-to-end e che si chieda di continuo: cosa sta succedendo? Perché? Cosa facciamo al riguardo? E, quando possibile, come lo automatizziamo?

Di cosa ti occuperai

Monitorare e analizzare le performance di prodotti, campagne, funnel e checkout
Presidiare KPI come CAC, CPA, ROAS, MER, tasso di conversione, LTV, retention e churn
Verificare e correggere problemi di tracciamento e attribuzione su piattaforme adv, CRM, checkout e payment processor
Costruire dashboard e sistemi di alert per il management e i team performance
Indagare le anomalie e risalire alle cause reali, senza fermarti ai sintomi
Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli sviluppatori per migliorare tracciamento e flusso dei dati
Individuare le attività manuali e ripetitive e contribuire ad automatizzarle: dall'insight all'azione

Cosa cerchiamo

Esperienza pratica e solida con Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4/GTM
SQL e ottime capacità di analisi dei dati
Esperienza nella creazione di dashboard e reportistica BI
Una reale comprensione tecnica di come i dati vengono generati, raccolti e archiviati
Curiosità, ragionamento lucido e capacità di entrare velocemente in sistemi sconosciuti

Nice to have: Python, tracciamento server-side, Meta CAPI, BigQuery/data warehouse, webhook, strumenti di automazione, sperimentazione e anomaly detection.

Perché questo ruolo

Accesso diretto sia a chi prende le decisioni di business sia a chi costruisce i sistemi. Responsabilità che cresce, non solo una lista di task che si allunga. L'occasione di definire fin da subito il modo in cui l'azienda usa i dati.

📍 Milano | 🏢 In sede | 🕐 Full-time | 🗣️ Inglese professionale richiesto

Come candidarsi

Inviaci il tuo CV insieme a una breve storia: raccontaci un problema reale che hai scoperto grazie ai dati (un bug di tracciamento, una campagna che sembrava funzionare ma non era così, un'automazione che hai costruito). Cosa hai notato, cosa hai fatto e com'è andata a finire.

L'annuncio è rivolto a candidati di tutti i generi (L. 903/77 e L. 125/91).
