Title: MIDDLE AI Architect & Data Science
Description:
Descrizione lavoro:

Gruppo Italgas

Italgas è una Network Tech Company, leader nei settori della distribuzione del gas, dei servizi idrici, dell’efficienza energetica e dell’IT. A seguito dell’acquisizione di 2i Rete Gas, suo principale competitor, Italgas diventa il primo operatore nella distribuzione del gas in Europa, gestendo una rete di oltre 150.000 chilometri e servendo circa 13 milioni di clienti in Italia e Grecia. Attraverso le sue controllate nel settore idrico, il Gruppo fornisce servizi, direttamente e indirettamente, a 6,2 milioni di persone, pari al 10% della popolazione italiana, principalmente nelle regioni Lazio, Sicilia e Campania.  Fondata nel 1837, Italgas è riconosciuta come la società che ha portato il gas nelle case degli italiani, contribuendo in modo significativo allo sviluppo economico e sociale del Paese. Con quasi due secoli di storia alle spalle è unanimemente riconosciuta come la società che ha portato il gas nelle case degli italiani, contribuendo allo sviluppo economico e sociale del Paese. 


In tale contesto è stata creata Bludigit S.p.A., società del Gruppo Italgas nata per dare ulteriore impulso alla trasformazione digitale di Italgas e per offrire soluzioni all’avanguardia anche ad altri operatori nei settori dell’energia e delle infrastrutture, per supportare e incentivare la transizione energetica e digitale. Bludigit, propone soluzioni proprietarie per accelerare la trasformazione digitale, attraverso un ecosistema di partner tecnologici e tramite la Digital Factory, l’hub di innovazione del Gruppo Italgas.

Job Description

Stiamo ricercando la seguente figura professionale: AI Architect & Data Science Middle che rappresenti il riferimento tecnico per la progettazione delle soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale e dei modelli analitici avanzati.
Cerchiamo una figura con forte competenza architetturale e di data science, che lavori in prima persona sulla progettazione dei modelli, sulla definizione delle architetture e sulla loro validazione tecnica, collaborando con engineer e data scientist del team.


Progettazione Architetturale
•    Progettare le architetture delle soluzioni AI, Machine Learning e Data Science, assicurando coerenza con gli standard tecnici e le best practice di settore.
•    Disegnare architetture dati basate su paradigmi Lakehouse e, ove rilevante, Data Mesh, per abilitare casi d’uso analitici avanzati.
•    Definire e documentare i pattern architetturali per l’adozione di soluzioni Generative AI (RAG, Vector Search, Lakehouse AI, Mosaic AI, AI Agent).
•    Valutare tecnologie, framework e piattaforme per lo sviluppo e il deployment di modelli AI/ML, producendo analisi comparative e raccomandazioni tecniche.
•    Redigere specifiche tecniche e linee guida per garantire riproducibilità, versionamento e qualità dei modelli.


Data Science Hands-on
•    Progettare e sviluppare modelli di Machine Learning, Deep Learning e NLP per casi d’uso industriali (manutenzione predittiva, ottimizzazione reti, anomaly detection).
•    Condurre analisi esplorative, feature engineering e selezione dei modelli più appropriati per ciascun caso d’uso.
•    Validare la correttezza e la robustezza dei modelli sviluppati dal team, eseguendo review tecniche e test di qualità.
•    Integrare LLM (open source e commerciali) e AI Agent nelle pipeline aziendali, occupandosi della progettazione e della validazione.
•    Assicurare la conformità alle best practice MLOps: monitoraggio del model drift, A/B testing, retraining.
•    Contribuire alla creazione di una knowledge base tecnica interna, documentando pattern, soluzioni e lesson learned.

Competenze Tecniche

Requisiti:
•    Esperienza di 4 – 6  anni in ruoli di AI/ML Architect, Senior Data Scientist o Applied Scientist su progetti complessi in contesti enterprise.
•    Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Statistica, Fisica o discipline affini.
•    Solida conoscenza di algoritmi di Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP e tecniche statistiche avanzate.
•    Esperienza approfondita con piattaforme cloud (Microsoft Azure, Databricks) e architetture Lakehouse.
•    Ottima conoscenza di Python e dei principali framework ML/AI (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face).
•    Esperienza con PySpark e tecnologie Big Data (Apache Spark, Delta Lake).
•    Conoscenza di strumenti MLOps (MLflow, Unity Catalog) e pratiche di CI/CD per modelli ML.
•    Esperienza con LLM, Generative AI e pattern architetturali come RAG e Vector Search.
•    Conoscenza di SQL e dei principi di modellazione dati (star schema, snowflake, granularità, relazioni).
•    Familiarità con strumenti di Data Governance e Data Quality (Unity Catalog, lineage, catalogazione).
•    Certificazioni Databricks o Microsoft Azure in ambito AI/ML. (Nice to Have)
 

Ulteriori competenze
•    Visione architetturale e capacità di tradurre requisiti complessi in soluzioni tecniche concrete.
•    Capacità di comunicare scelte architetturali a interlocutori con diversi livelli di tecnicità.
•    Pensiero analitico e approccio scientifico rigoroso alla risoluzione dei problemi.
•    Disponibilità al confronto tecnico e alla review tra pari.
•    Curiosità verso le tecnologie emergenti e aggiornamento continuo.
•    Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
•    Disponibilità a periodiche trasferte, se necessarie.

Cosa Offriamo
•    Opportunità di crescita professionale in un contesto data-driven in forte espansione.
•    Ambiente di lavoro innovativo nel settore Data & AI.
•    Formazione continua sulle tecnologie emergenti (Databricks, Azure, GenAI).


Sede: Milano\Torino

Dati retribuzione

Condizioni contrattuali ed economiche

Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato.
L’inquadramento previsto per il ruolo è: 7°-8° livello del CCNL Gas Acqua.
La corrispondente RAL di base per il contratto a tempo indeterminato è prevista nell’intervallo tra 45.000 e 55.000 €, distribuita su 14 mensilità.

Si aggiungono:
•    Premio di produzione, collegato al raggiungimento di obiettivi aziendali predefiniti e misurabili (es. sicurezza, qualità del servizio, performance operative), convertibile in servizi di welfare;
•    Buoni pasto del valore nominale di 12 € giornalieri (in presenza) o 7 € giornalieri (in smart working);

Title: Air quality modeler
Description:
Who are we?

SUEZ is a world leader in smart and sustainable resource management, and our Air & Climate unit provides consulting services and develop and deploy digital solutions that address the key environmental needs of our customers.

ARIANET, the Air & Climate unit in Italy, delivers studies, develops, designs, installs and manages cutting-edge solutions related to air quality management: diagnostic, real-time monitoring, forecast and scenario studies, for a proven customer base of industries, public and para-public entities.

To provide the best environmental solutions for our customers, we are strengthening our applied modeling team which performs studies and develops and manage simulation systems in industrial and urban areas.

In this context, we are looking for an:




Air quality modeler

Your mission

You will join the ARIANET team, and you will be involved in atmospheric modelling, concerning mainly dispersion, chemical transformation and ground deposition of pollutants at regional and urban scales.

You will mainly use a simulation system including meteorological and emission models and based on FARM (Flexible Air Quality Regional Model) chemical-transport model, developed by ARIANET in collaboration with national and international research centers and with a significant user base.

You will contribute to the multiple applications of the system, typically: operational forecast of ambient air quality, yearly air quality assessments, reconstruction of past events, estimation of sources contributions, scenario studies in support of policy planning and impact assessment studies. These activities will also include drafting the relevant technical reports and presenting the results to clients, mostly public but also private.

You will progressively participate in the development of the models’ new features, documenting them.

You will also be able to actively participate in research activities carried out within European projects and to contribute to the drafting of scientific publications.




Your profile

You are the one if you:

have a master's degree in physics, engineering, environmental sciences, or related disciplines
possess basic knowledge of atmospheric physics and/or meteorology, acquired through university courses or documented post-graduate experience
have 2-4 years’ work experience in the field of atmospheric modelling
have a good command of Unix/Linux environments and of Fortran or Python programming languages
have good knowledge of the English language and good writing skills
have a strong motivation and interest in actively working in the environmental field
have good analytical and communication skills
can work independently while coordinating within a team







Following proven expertise and skills are a strong plus:

PhD in meteorology, atmospheric physics or chemistry, natural sciences, environmental engineering
experience with numerical modeling and scientific programming
high-performance computing environments, parallelization and optimization of computational codes
use of machine-learning in support of quantitative analyses and modelling in environmental field
use of GIS for environmental applications
CFD modelling




Conditions

Full-time job.

Place of work: Milano.

Salary: 32-38 k€ yearly gross (excluding bonus), commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate.










SUEZ encourages and values diversity in gender, ethnicity, generation, culture, health, physical condition, sexual orientation, etc.

Title: AI DEVELOPER
Description:
Chi cerchiamo

Per la nostra sede di Milano – Piazza Trento siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire come AI Developer all’interno del team “AI Factory”. La struttura ha lo scopo di presidiare lo sviluppo e la configurazione di soluzioni AI.

Per quale Società 

A2A Life Ventures. A2A Life Ventures nasce dall’esperienza e dalla visione innovativa del Gruppo A2A per supportare le Business Unit nell’accelerare la transizione energetica e ambientale. Evolutasi dal polo di innovazione del Gruppo in una piattaforma integrata di venture capital, venture building, sviluppo tecnologico, AI e partnership strategiche, opera come motore di crescita per nuove soluzioni ad alto potenziale. Trasforma idee e tecnologie emergenti in soluzioni ad alto impatto, creando valore per il Gruppo, per il mercato e per i territori. Un ecosistema aperto che connette ricerca, industria e startup per anticipare le sfide della sostenibilità e favorire la nascita di nuovi modelli industriali.

Ti occuperai di


Sviluppo Agentico e Generativo: progettare e implementare applicazioni basate su Agentic AI e architetture RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), orchestrando modelli LLM per interagire con database e sistemi aziendali

Title: Deep AI native software engineer
Description:
YOU ARE

As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and DevOps & MLOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

THE WORK



Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions

Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems; design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps

Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC

Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites

Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production

Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools

Justify the value of model approaches in business problems

Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production



EDUCATION





Bachelor's Degree or equivalent



Basic (required) Qualification



Proven experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.

Experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming

Hands-on experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks

Experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.



Preferred Qualification



Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..

Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.

Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL

Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment

Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams

Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation

MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)



Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the Metalmeccanico National Collective Bargaining Agreement applies, with one of the following pay grades and corresponding gross annual salary range:

B2- €32,000 - €50,500

B3- €36,000 - €65,800

Title: Junior - Credit Risk Modelling| Milan
Description:
Junior – Credit Risk Modelling| Milan

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions. When you join the Financial Risk team in Milan , you are going to work on Credit Risk Modelling projects, for top-tier clients in the Financial Services sector.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:


developing models for the quantification of the main credit risk parameters (PD, LGD and EAD) for management and regulatory purposes, in line with Basel regulations;
assisting clients with stress test;
contributing to the inclusion of ESG topics in risk measurement;
measurement of financial instruments (fixed income, securitisation and derivatives);
implementing pricing models for complex financial instruments (e.g., CLN, ABS, securitisation and CMS);
restructuring of derivative portfolios and development of the related financial models.


Skills

Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity if you have:


a specialist degree (graduate or nearing completion) in business, statistics, engineering, mathematics or any other quantitative faculty;
knowledge of programming software and languages (Python, SAS, R, Matlab and Stata);
excellent knowledge of Italian and English, preferably with study and/or work experience abroad;
excellent problem-solving skills and an innate ability to take initiative;
good interpersonal and teamwork skills.


Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG


An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity.
A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork.
Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programmes to stay current.
International mindset and innovative projects.
Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being.


Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a gross annual salary of €29,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our values and commitment

Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential.

As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125, relating to gender equality” . Within our Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - you will find summarised all the actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.

Join us!

Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) no. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - “GDPR”), as amended. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy .

KPMG Advisory S.p.A. is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Tech Architect - ML & AI Engineer | Advanced Analytics
Description:
Tech Architect ML & AI Engineer | Advanced Analytics

Sedi: Roma, Milano, Bologna, Torino, Napoli, Padova

In Avanade siamo alla ricerca di Machine Learning & AI Engineer appassionati di Intelligenza Artificiale e innovazione, con almeno 5/6 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale in contesti aziendali strutturati; competenze di people management.

Entrerai a far parte del team Advanced Analytics, all’interno dell’area Data & AI, e contribuirai alla progettazione e allo sviluppo di progetti di Data Science, tra cui modelli predittivi, soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), agenti intelligenti e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Together we do what matters.

Cosa Farai


Collaborerai con altri ML & AI Engineers, sviluppatori full stack AI, data engineers e solution architects per integrare modelli ML/AI in architetture cloud moderne.
Scriverai codice Python/PySpark di alta qualità e SQL per l’analisi e la trasformazione dei dati.
Lavorerai con modelli tradizionali di Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
Svilupperai soluzioni basate su Large Language Models, con conoscenza di tecnologie come RAG e agenti intelligenti.
Progetterai e svilupperai pipeline di ML e soluzioni AI, dalla fase di prototipazione alla messa in produzione
Utilizzerai strumenti di MLOps e DevOps per la gestione, versionamento e deployment dei modelli.
Contribuirai al confronto con i clienti, traducendo esigenze di business in soluzioni AI efficaci.


Qualifications

Competenze ed esperienze:

Il Profilo Ideale Possiede Buona Parte Delle Seguenti Competenze


Solida conoscenza di Python per il Machine Learning e la Data Science.
Solida conoscenza di SQL e modellazione dei dati.
Esperienza con librerie di Machine Learning (es. Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Prophet).
Esperienza con i framework di Deep Learning (es. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).
Familiarità con strumenti di MLOps (es. MLFlow).
Esperienza con Large Language Models, tecniche di prompting e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Esperienza con piattaforme e servizi Cloud Microsoft come Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric e/o Databricks (ML/GenAI).
Conoscenza delle pratiche di versionamento con Git, testing, CI/CD.
competenze di people management


Nice To Have


Esperienza con i principali framework per LLM come LangChain, LangGraph e LlamaIndex.
Esperienza con LLM open-source (LLaMA, Mistral, Mixtral) e tecniche di ottimizzazione (LoRA, fine-tuning).
Esperienza con Hugging Face Transformers.
Esperienza con servizi come AI Foundry.
Esperienza in deployment di modelli AI su infrastrutture containerizzate (Docker, Kubernetes).
Certificazioni rilevanti in ambito AI/ML, tra cui:
Microsoft: AZ-900, AI-900, AI-102, AI-100, DP-100, DP-600
Databricks: Machine Learning Associate, Machine Learning ---Professional, Databricks Certified GenAI Practitioner


Il Tuo Profilo


Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science o discipline affini.
Analitico, curioso, agile, paziente e orientato alla qualità
Capacità di lavorare in team cross-funzionali e di comunicare efficacemente con stakeholder tecnici e non.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About The Company

Scrambly is one of the fastest-growing adtech startups in the world, featured in the AppsFlyer Performance Index and Singular ROI Index in just 3.5 years.

We’re growing 250%+ YoY across revenue, team, product, and technology — fully bootstrapped and profitable.

We’re building the future of app discovery: a reward-powered alternative to the App Store and Google Play. Our loyalty-driven ecosystem connects millions of users with the world’s top apps and delivers unmatched, ROI-focused growth for mobile advertisers.

Our mission is to build a true alternative to traditional app stores — fueled by rewards and data — and create a new, performance-first growth engine for mobile app advertisers.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the models behind how Scrambly spends and makes money — what our users are worth, what we should pay to acquire and reward them, and how we keep the ecosystem free of abuse.

The centre of the role is predicting user and cohort value — forecasting what people will be worth from early signal, and keeping those forecasts accurate as the product and the market move underneath them. Around it sits a set of connected problems across marketing, monetisation, and risk, each of which turns a prediction into a decision the business acts on. We will go through the specifics with you during the process.

You will own the modelling end to end: framing the problem, building the model, deciding how it is evaluated, and staying with it once it is live. You will not be doing that alone — you will work closely with our engineers on data, pipelines, serving, and integration.

This is an early hire on a data team being built from scratch, reporting to and working day to day with the Head of Data. We are flexible on level. The title reflects the ownership and independence the role carries, not a hard experience bar — we will set the level, title, and compensation to match what you bring.

Key Responsibilities


Value prediction. Own and improve how we forecast user and cohort value from early behaviour, across our different revenue streams. Improve accuracy where it matters most commercially, and keep the models working as the product changes.
Bidding and pricing. Build the modelling that decides what we are willing to pay to acquire users, together with the controls that keep spend inside margin limits while the system is still learning.
Segmentation and targeting. Build the scoring and segmentation that lets us treat users, partners, and inventory according to the value they actually deliver.
Fraud and abuse. Improve the accuracy of our fraud models, and balance catching abuse against wrongly penalising real users.
Evaluation. Decide how each model is judged and hold that line — out-of-sample discipline, backtesting, and choosing metrics that reflect the commercial objective rather than the convenient one. Stay close to your models once they are live, and flag when accuracy starts to slip.
Collaboration. Work with the Head of Data on prioritisation, with our engineers on data pipelines and serving, and with commercial teams on turning model output into decisions they trust.


Requirements


4+ years as a data scientist working on production models that drive real decisions. We care more about what you have owned than about the number.
Hands-on experience with LTV or ROAS prediction — forecasting user or cohort value from early behaviour, and dealing with the problems that come with it: immature cohorts, long horizons, sparse segments, and models that decay as the product changes. This is the core of the role and we are looking for someone who has done it before.
Adtech or mobile performance marketing background — attribution and MMP data, cohort and campaign economics, and how UA spend actually gets decided. Backgrounds in gaming, gambling, or user-incentive and loyalty systems are equally relevant, and experience with rewarded, offerwall, or incentivised apps is a significant advantage.
Strong Python and SQL, with production experience on a cloud data warehouse — BigQuery preferred.
Rigour about evaluation: you choose the metric that matches the business objective, you are careful about out-of-sample and point-in-time correctness, and you are willing to say a model is not good enough to ship.
Experience of models that made it into production and were used to make real decisions — you understand what it takes to get there and what happens to a model afterwards.
Commercial judgement and clear communication — able to explain a model to people who will spend money based on it, and to push back when the data does not support the question being asked.
A proactive, self-directed way of working. You will be in a very small team, with a lot of latitude and little process.
English at B2+, written and spoken — you will document your work and work daily with an international team.


Nice to Have


Bidding, pricing, or budget allocation systems — control loops, bandits, or other approaches to spending under uncertainty.
Fraud, anomaly detection, or trust & safety modelling, especially with weak or incomplete labels.
Experimentation and causal inference — A/B design, power analysis, and incrementality measurement.
Survival, hierarchical, or Bayesian methods applied to retention, monetisation, or sparse-segment problems.
BQML, Dataform, or dbt, or other experience building models close to the warehouse.
Deploying and monitoring models yourself — pipelines, serving, retraining, and drift monitoring.


What We Offer


Ownership of the models that set UA spend, offer payouts, and fraud decisions — work directly attached to revenue, with visible impact within weeks.
Problems with real depth: long-horizon forecasting, adaptivity, pricing under uncertainty, and fraud with imperfect ground truth.
A close working relationship with the Head of Data, a real say in how the data function is built, and room to grow as the team expands.
A level and compensation matched to what you bring, rather than to the title on the advert.
A profitable, bootstrapped company growing 250%+ YoY, where investment in data is justified by results rather than budget cycles.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Let's build the future of AI & Data, together 🧙

At Data Wizards, we're focused on 3 things: Data, AI & you.

We're a small team who genuinely love digging into data that makes a real difference for the companies we work with, and who want to discover how AI and data can help companies out there.

Why join us? Apart from tackling exciting challenges with passionate people in an environment that wants to see you thrive, you'll be part of a young company that keeps its feet on the ground, its eyes on the stars, and believes the best growth comes from the unique magic each Wizard brings.

We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. But this job description is for Senior Data Scientists out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄

We are currently looking for a senior data scientist for a fraud detection project where you would do:


Strengthening our fraud models by improving how we collect, label, structure and engineer features from complex transactional and behavioral data
Designing, building and continuously refining fraud detection models using machine learning, graph analytics, anomaly detection and behavioral analytics
Turning large volumes of transactional and customer data into actionable fraud intelligence through feature engineering, data enrichment and pattern discovery
Partnering with Fraud Operations, Risk, Compliance and Product teams to spot emerging fraud trends and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions
Digging into complex fraud schemes, uncovering new attack vectors and building proactive detection strategies that protect the business financially and reputationally
But being a consulting company, we can't know in advance what your exact responsibilities will be



You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:

Background


At least 5 years of experience in data science, with a solid grounding in fraud detection, ideally within the financial sector
A Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science or engineering. A PhD is a plus, and candidates with a different academic background but strong analytical skills are equally welcome



Technical Skills


Hands-on experience processing large-scale, complex transactional and behavioral datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas) and distributed processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop
Proven ability to apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics and network analysis to detect, investigate and prevent fraud. Experience with generative AI is a plus
Strong Python skills, with experience deploying AI applications into production; familiarity with Java is a plus



Soft Skills


Autonomous & Proactive: You take initiative and drive projects forward.
Curious & Adaptive: You embrace learning and thrive in dynamic environments.
Solution-Oriented: You balance technical rigor with business impact.
Clear Communicator: You simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.
Collaborative & Supportive: You work well in teams.
Creative Thinker: You find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
Languages: Fluent in English, French and/or Dutch.



We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.

Here's a sneak peek at what we offer:

💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated


Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
Opportunity to earn company stock over time



🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive


Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces, a Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles, a massage chair for those deep-thinking moments and fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕



✨ And most importantly, an organic-growing company where you are in control of your own path!

Our Recruitment Process:

📲Quick intro call with our HR team (5')

💜Culture check: HR Interview (30')

🛠️Technical check: Wizard assessment (25') & Technical Interview with our wizards (1h)

🤝Partner Meet-up (30')

Why this process?

We want you to get a genuine feel for who we are, and we want to make sure we're aligned on what truly matters. Rather than rushing the process, we focus on finding the right fit, so that six months from now, both sides are still convinced they made the right decision.

➡️If you're passionate about what we do but aren't sure you meet every single requirement, don't hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.

➡️Please note: As a consulting company, our recruitment process can be either project-driven or based on strong profiles we believe in. The consultancy world moves fast, and while we always aim to match great talent with the right opportunity, there might not always be an immediate fit. With your permission, we'll gladly keep your profile in mind for future missions, and hope to collaborate with you soon on an exciting project at Data Wizards!

Les statistiques

Title: Senior Data Scientist – MMM Expert
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Help our clients in their AI transformations

Who We Are

Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in AI applications to help clients achieve tangible business impact. Our Belgium office advises clients on their most pressing strategic challenges : from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design. Our inclusive and forward-thinking culture encourages creativity, collaboration, and professional growth.

What You Will Do

As a Senior Data Scientist specializing in the marketing domain, you will lead and conduct ambitious projects aimed at transforming clients through data. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:


Leading transformational projects: spearheading ambitious projects that utilize data to transform our clients’ operations and strategies.
Developing data science solutions: creating innovative data science products and solutions for both clients and our internal data science team.
Applying data science in marketing contexts: leveraging data science methodologies to enhance marketing analytics, customer segmentation, attribution modeling, and campaign optimization.
Building client relationships: collaborating closely with your Consulting counterpart to understand client needs and strengthen relationships.
Upskilling the team: contributing to the development of our data science team by sharing knowledge, mentoring junior Data Scientists, and promoting our work within other data departments.
Ensuring quality deliverables: caring for team morale and ensuring that all missions are delivered to a high standard, providing feedback and support to less experienced team members.
Optimising code: writing highly optimized code to advance Artefact’s internal toolbox and knowledge base.


What You Will Learn With Us


Real-World impact: deliver impactful projects by developing end-to-end machine learning pipelines to solve real-world problems across various industries, including marketing and customer intelligence.
Collaborative solutions: work in feature teams alongside other data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, and product owners to build complex solutions.
Software engineering improvement: enhance your software engineering skills by applying ML Ops best practices while working with machine learning teams.
Expertise development: become an expert in one of our data science practices: Time Series Forecasting, MLOps, NLP, Computer Vision, Optimization, or Customer Intelligence, including marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing.
Algorithm discovery: discover state-of-the-art algorithms and test them on real-world data during client projects.


Who You Are

We’re seeking someone who has:


Educational background: a completed Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, machine learning, mathematics, or related subjects).
Hands-On experience: at least 2-3 years of experience in data science, analytics, or consulting, preferably within a marketing or digital context.
Marketing or digital context experience: knowledge of various marketing channels and platforms, including their roles within the media mix is considered a plus.
Technical skills: strong knowledge of data processing, algorithms, and data architecture, along with proficiency in tools like Python, SQL, and R.
Analytical mindset: a passion for working with data to derive actionable insights and solve complex problems.
Communication skills: excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to discuss both technical and non-technical topics with clients and team members.
Curiosity and passion: a genuine interest in continuous learning and exploring new technologies and tools in data and AI.


What We Offer


Competitive compensation aligned with your profile and experience.
Hands-on exposure to real client challenges from day one, working alongside experienced strategy and data/AI practitioners.
Regular training in both strategy consulting methodologies and AI/data capabilities, combined with international exposure across Artefact's global network.
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture of doers — innovative, fast-moving, and committed to supporting each other's growth.


This position is based in Brussels, with opportunities to collaborate on projects worldwide.

At Artefact Belgium, we value curiosity, motivation, and potential above all else. Don't worry if you don't tick every box — if you're excited about building a career at the frontier of strategy and AI, we'd love to hear from you

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Position Description

The opportunity

Join CGI's multidisciplinary innovation environment and help clients turn data into decisions, products and new ways of working. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will frame complex business questions, design robust analytical approaches and build AI and machine-learning solutions that create practical value.

You will combine technical delivery with consulting: translating emerging trends into relevant client solutions, making insights easy to understand, supporting business development and helping less-experienced colleagues grow.

Only candidates legally residing in Belgium will be considered for this position.

C2-level in one of the 2 national languages and at least B2-level in the other and strong English proficiency is also mandatory.

What you will do


Frame the right problems. Work with clients and multidisciplinary teams to translate business challenges into clear analytical questions, hypotheses, success measures and realistic delivery plans.
Build advanced analytics solutions. Develop, evaluate and improve machine-learning and statistical models for classification, regression, forecasting, NLP and other relevant use cases.
Create reliable experiments. Explore and prepare data, select appropriate methods, design experiments and validate results with attention to quality, bias, explainability and business relevance.
Make insights actionable. Translate model outputs and complex findings into clear visualisations, recommendations and narratives that decision-makers can understand and use.
Support industrialisation. Collaborate with data, software and cloud engineers to move promising models towards secure, maintainable and scalable production solutions.
Shape client strategy and growth. Connect industry and technology trends to client operations, contribute to workshops and proposals, and help create new opportunities with existing and prospective CGI clients.
Mentor and collaborate. Coach colleagues, review approaches and share good practices while working openly with experts from different disciplines to find the strongest solution.


What you bring


Relevant education and experience. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Econometrics or another discipline with a strong statistical component, plus at least 5 years of experience in the data domain.
Python and/or R. Strong practical skills with the data-science ecosystem, including tools such as pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, matplotlib or equivalent libraries.
Machine learning and advanced analytics. Proven experience solving complex problems through data analysis, modelling and evaluation, including classification and regression techniques.
Natural language processing. Experience with NLP concepts and libraries such as spaCy, NLTK or Stanford NLP, and the ability to select an appropriate approach for the use case.
Data and cloud platforms. Experience with advanced analytics and large datasets, together with practical knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
Consulting and communication. Strong problem-solving, stakeholder and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical choices and results to non-specialist audiences.
Agile collaboration. Comfort working iteratively in Agile environments, taking ownership of deliverables and collaborating across business, data, engineering and design disciplines.
Additional assets. Experience in software development or DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, MLOps, computer vision, Unity, Linked Data, semantic technologies or knowledge graphs is an advantage.


A pre-employment screening is part of the application process.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium

Company: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium

Employment Type: Full-time




Nature of the Tasks

Collaborate with stakeholders to collect requirements, frame business problems as data science hypotheses, define success metrics, and develop or deploy advanced data mining and machine learning solutions.
Collaborate with User Experience (UX) and product teams to specify design requirements for the effective presentation and interpretation of model outputs and insights.
Develop process to monitor and analyse data accuracy.
Identify, collect, and prepare data for analysis, collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure robust production-grade data pipelines, with a focus on feature engineering and data readiness for modelling.
Produce data models according to specific problem statements.
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and scripts to solve specific business problems.
Collaborate with Data Analysts and Architects on the design of the analytics architecture to ensure it supports the scalability and performance requirements of data science models.
Write the different documentation associated with the tasks and liaise with other teams as necessary to address cross-system interdependencies.
Develop visualizations to communicate model behaviour, key insights, and performance metrics, and collaborate with Data Analysts on integrated dashboard reporting.
Design, develop, and evaluate predictive models capable of handling both structured and unstructured data, including model selection, training, and hyperparameter tuning.
Elaborate processes to ensure the compliant implementation of regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act), including model risk management, monitoring for drift/bias, and comprehensive documentation (e.g., model cards).
Ensure that model development, deployment, and monitoring practices adhere to all relevant regulatory frameworks and internal governance policies.
Communicate model insights, limitations, and behaviour effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, and create interpretable outputs and documentation.
Conduct rigorous experiment design (e.g., A/B testing), employ cross-validation techniques, and perform statistical significance testing to validate findings and model performance.
Deploy and maintain models into production using Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, model registries, and ensuring reproducibility.




Specific Expertise and Technologies

Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques and tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, Spark) to design and implement data-driven solutions.
Knowledge of machine learning and natural language processing (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) to build predictive and text-based models.

Bij Select Projects draait alles om jou als consultant. We willen dat jij elke dag met goesting aan de slag gaat, jezelf kan zijn en de ruimte krijgt om te groeien. Wil jij meebouwen aan één van de meest geavanceerde farmaceutische productiesites ter wereld? Je ontwikkelt slimme data-oplossingen die een directe impact hebben op kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en efficiëntie van productieprocessen. Samenwerken met stakeholders om data om te zetten naar verbeteringen
Documenteren van modellen en resultaten conform GMP-richtlijnen


Profiel kandidaat

Je houdt ervan om complexe problemen analytisch te benaderen en weet data om te zetten naar bruikbare inzichten. Daarbij werk je zelfstandig, maar stem je ook vlot af met verschillende stakeholders. Je communiceert helder en weet technische informatie begrijpelijk over te brengen.

Hard Skills


Bachelor of master in Data Science, Informatica, Engineering of gelijkaardig
Minimaal 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring binnen data science of analytics
Sterke kennis van Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
Ervaring met SQL, machine learning en LLM-toepassingen
Goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels; GMP-ervaring is een plus


Geboden wordt

Bij Select Projects sta je er nooit alleen voor. Ook al werk je bij een klant, je blijft deel van een warme, hechte groep consultants waar verbondenheid centraal staat. Werken bij Select Projects voelt als thuiskomen in een team waar je gesteund wordt, waar successen samen gevierd worden en waar jij kan groeien – op jouw tempo, als professional én als persoon.

Daarnaast biedt Select Projects je een vast contract van onbepaalde duur aan.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR

We help large enterprises cut energy costs and valorize flexibility by steering their energy use in sync with market prices and renewable generation.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to develop the forecasting, optimization, and control algorithms at the core of Companion's platform.

You'll work on energy demand forecasting, market price prediction, and real-time asset control: models and algorithms that drive second-by-second decisions worth millions.




About Companion.energy

Companion.energy connects the financial side of energy management (contracts, markets, risk) with the operational side (assets, processes, sites). We model complex energy contracts and flexible assets, forecast demand and production, and translate predictions into automated, second-by-second control decisions that move megawatts and money. Our software is used by large B2B enterprises and energy players to lower OPEX, maximize revenue, increase renewable usage, and manage risk.




Why Companion.energy?

Work on hard problems: Real-time forecasting, optimization, and closed-loop control in complex, stochastic energy systems. Your models and controllers move megawatts.
See your work in production: Models you build get deployed and measured against real financial outcomes daily. Controllers you design steer real assets in real time.
Join early, help shape the future: Small team, big impact. You'll shape Companion's data, ML, and control strategy.
A mission that matters: Better forecasting and smarter control accelerate the transition to a flexible, renewable grid.




What you'll work on

Forecasting models for energy demand, renewable production, and market prices — including the uncertainty estimates that feed downstream control.
Control algorithms that translate forecasts and market signals into real-time asset dispatch decisions (battery steering, load shifting, balancing market participation), accounting for the inherent stochasticity of prices, generation, and demand.
Optimization pipelines that schedule flexibility across portfolios of assets and markets under uncertainty.
Closing the loop: connecting prediction, planning, and execution into systems that operate autonomously in a stochastic environment.




What we are looking for

Strong foundation in machine learning, time series forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience with control algorithms: model predictive control (MPC), stochastic optimal control, or similar approaches to real-time decision-making under uncertainty and constraints.
Proficiency in Python and the standard data/scientific computing stack (pandas, NumPy/SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent).
Experience with short-term power or flexibility trading
Experience working with real-world, messy time series data.
Comfort deploying models and control algorithms in production environments, not just notebooks.
Interest in or knowledge of energy systems: electricity markets, load forecasting, asset dispatch, balancing mechanisms, or related domains.
Pragmatic approach: you understand the difference between a theoretically optimal solution and one that ships and delivers value under real-world uncertainty.
Experience with mathematical optimization (linear/quadratic programming, mixed-integer formulations, stochastic programming) is a strong plus.




Location

Belgium (hybrid)




How we hire

Intro call → technical case → follow-up conversations with the team and founders.

We keep it simple and can move fast.




Ready to apply?

Send a short email to apply@companion.energy with your resume attached. Tell us why this role excites you and share something relevant: a model you built, a control system you designed, a Kaggle notebook, or a project that shows how you approach data and engineering problems.

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Omschrijving

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

De job in een notendop

AI- & ML-solution development:


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur:


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie:


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance:


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement:


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van:
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, enz.

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (NL/FR).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

    • machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
    • genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, enz.
  • Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
  • Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
  • Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.

  • Full-stack skills.

Title: Consultant Senior - Data Science & AI (Trilingual NL/EN/FR)
Description:
Senior Data Scientist, AI & Machine Learning | Brussels




At Exsolvæ, our consultants carry the title of Solver, and it's a title you earn. We take the development of every Solver seriously, each one belongs to a Core Domain, works with a Leader who actually follows their progress, and presents their work in Cerebro sessions to colleagues who know the field as well as they do. It's a demanding place, on purpose.




The Data Science & AI Core Domain serves some of the biggest names across finance, retail, automotive, ... clients who run AI in production and pay dearly when a model gets it wrong.




That's the work we're hiring for.




Your role, on mission

Design and build AI applications that create measurable value for customers and employees, from intelligent automation to decision support
Own the full lifecycle: framing use cases with business stakeholders, prototyping, production deployment, monitoring
Set up rigorous evaluation: reference datasets, quality metrics and the safeguards that keep models reliable in production
Work in agile squads and present your results directly to senior management




Your role, within the community

Share what you learn: Cerebro sessions, co-built playbooks, code reviews between Solvers
Mentor peers and be mentored: seniors who enjoy passing on what they know do well here
Help shape where the Core Domain goes next




Must-haves

Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science); a PhD is an asset
Senior profile: minimum 5 years of professional experience in data science and analytics
A proven track record of AI applications shipped to production, including at least one agentic AI solution (LLM-based agents, orchestration, tool use) that you can walk us through in detail
Expert Python with solid engineering practices (git, testing, production-grade code)
Hands-on experience with deep learning and modern model architectures
Trilingual, mandatory: fluent English, fluent French or Dutch, and full professional proficiency in the other national language (FR or NL)
Based in Belgium and available on-site in Brussels roughly half the time
A genuine desire to be part of a community: you share what you know and you show up for the collective moments




Strong assets

Agent orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, MCP, Google ADK
LLM evaluation and safety: guardrails, red teaming
Natural language processing and speech technologies
On-premise model deployment in regulated environments
MLOps: monitoring, testing and delivery pipelines for models
Enterprise data science platforms, SQL, bash
Financial services background




Joining Exsolvæ, concretely

A community before anything else: a Core Domain led by a Leader who follows your development, Cerebro sessions where Solvers present and learn, playbooks built together
A Knowledge & Networking budget to keep learning and stay plugged into the ecosystem (emerging AI topics, MLOps, AI governance)
A followed career path with a dedicated Manager, regular check-ins, an evolution committee that formalises your progression and issue recommandations
Long-run missions at leading companies, in production
A permanent employee contract, with a competitive package aligned with your seniority




Interested, or know someone who fits? Apply here or reach out to us!




Exsolvæ is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and select on skills and motivation only.

Title: Medior Data Scientist
Description:
Over de functie

Voor een geavanceerde farmaceutische omgeving zoeken we een Medior Data Scientist / Engineer die wil bijdragen aan de digitale transformatie van een moderne productieomgeving. De site behoort tot de internationale top en richt zich op de productie van actieve farmaceutische ingrediënten (API’s) en eindproducten die wereldwijd worden ingezet.

De organisatie investeert sterk in Industry 4.0, data-gedreven werken en procesoptimalisatie. Binnen dit kader speelt het Smart Factory-team een sleutelrol in het ontwikkelen van slimme, schaalbare oplossingen die productieprocessen efficiënter, veiliger en betrouwbaarder maken.

Jouw missie

Als Medior Data Scientist / Engineer werk je mee aan het ontwikkelen en implementeren van data-oplossingen die een directe impact hebben op productieprestaties. Je vertaalt complexe datasets naar concrete verbeteringen en ondersteunt operationele teams met inzichten en innovatieve toepassingen, waaronder machine learning en AI.

Je werkt nauw samen met procesingenieurs, kwaliteitsspecialisten en IT-professionals.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Data & Analyse


Verzamelen, verwerken en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden productiedata uit diverse bronnen (o.a. proceshistorians, MES-systemen en sensoren)
Ontwikkelen van robuuste data pipelines en analytische modellen in Python en SQL
Uitvoeren van statistische analyses en root cause analyses ter ondersteuning van procesverbetering



Machine Learning & AI


Ontwerpen, trainen en valideren van machine learning modellen (o.a. predictive maintenance, anomaliedetectie, procesoptimalisatie)
Verkennen en toepassen van AI- en LLM-oplossingen binnen een productiecontext (bijv. documentverwerking en kennisextractie)
Monitoren en continu verbeteren van modelprestaties



Smart Factory Initiatieven


Actief bijdragen aan digitale roadmap en innovatieprojecten
Samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams om data-oplossingen te vertalen naar operationele waarde
Documenteren van modellen en methodologieën volgens kwaliteits- en compliancevereisten



Stakeholdermanagement


Vertalen van complexe data-inzichten naar begrijpelijke communicatie voor niet-technische stakeholders
Ondersteunen van adoptie en verandering bij de implementatie van nieuwe tools en processen



Vereiste kwalificaties

Opleiding


Bachelor- of masterdiploma in Data Science, Informatica, Ingenieurswetenschappen, Toegepaste Wiskunde of een gelijkaardig domein



Technische vaardigheden


Python (o.a. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) voor data-analyse en modellering
SQL en ervaring met relationele databases
Machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, time-series)
Kennis van Large Language Models en relevante toepassingen (bijv. fine-tuning, prompt engineering, agents)
Ervaring met industriële data-omgevingen en IIoT-context is een plus



Professionele competenties


2 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring in data science of analytics
Sterk analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen
Zelfstandig kunnen werken en tegelijk goed functioneren in teamverband
Resultaatgericht, nauwkeurig en in staat prioriteiten te stellen
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels



Pluspunten

Ervaring met één of meerdere van onderstaande is een meerwaarde:


Industriële dataplatformen en procesdata-infrastructuur (bijv. PI System)
Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
Geavanceerde analysetools voor tijdreeksdata
Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
Ervaring met ontwikkelomgevingen en moderne AI-codetools



Daarnaast is ervaring binnen een gereguleerde omgeving (bijv. farmaceutische, biotech- of chemische sector) een sterke troef.

Contactperson & Reference


Reference #: INCA27877

Title: Senior Data Science Analyst - OptimusAI
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Science Specialist, you’ll collaborate in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3–6 experts, using your creativity and analytics expertise to drive client performance in areas like energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You’ll work side-by-side with client process engineers and analytics specialists, presenting your insights directly to executive audiences.

Internally, you’ll partner with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms that address both current and future client needs. You’ll play a key role in codifying best practices, amplifying our impact both inside and outside the firm, and shaping the product roadmap.

You’ll be based in our Brussels office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution, OptimusAI, which sits at the intersection of three practices: Global Energy and Materials, QuantumBlack, and Operations.

Global Energy and Materials: Advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.

QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey: The AI arm of our firm, helping clients transform faster, innovate smarter, and anticipate the future.

Operations: Assists clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing strategies and solutions for their most critical problems—connecting boardroom strategies to shop floor operators.

At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics. We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in plant control rooms, optimize process control systems, and unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.

OptimusAI also supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying our approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You’ll benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. Experience unparalleled career growth, with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. Plus, seize the opportunity to travel to client sites—locally and around the world.

There is a flexibility to hire at different role level, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics, ideally within heavy industry environments
Advanced Python programming skills, with a passion for writing clean, efficient, modular, and maintainable code
Proven ability to implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for seamless model integration and deployment
Strong DevOps and backend engineering capabilities, including experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Self-starter with excellent organizational abilities—able to independently initiate tasks and drive them to completion
Skilled in making rational, data-driven decisions based on facts and logical reasoning
Ability to create high-quality work products, such as PowerPoint presentations, Excel models, articles, or other written outputs
Exceptional time management skills to thrive in a complex, largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to work or attend meetings outside traditional business hours, and to take on projects at short notice when needed
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences and seniority levels

Title: Financial Risk Modeler - Data Scientist
Description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? You’re not alone. Join us in driving progress in the working world and beyond.

Your journey with us

Deloitte Belgium’s Financial Risk department helps organizations identify the risks impacting their business and implement effective and efficient processes to measure and manage these risks (mainly market, credit and liquidity risk). To this end, the team leverages its expertise in data analytics, machine learning techniques and process optimization, combined with a strong understanding of the regulatory and business context.

As a Quantitative Modeler, you will be developing, validating and implementing advanced mathematical and statistical models to address complex financial and business challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong academic background, experience in quantitative methods, and a deep understanding of financial instruments and markets.

What will you be doing?

You Will Join a Team Of Experienced Risk Modelers Where Collaboration And Communication Are At The Heart Of Our Way Of Working. You Are Curious And Analytical, With a Natural Drive To Excel. Amongst Other, Your Activities Will Include


Model Development: Design and develop quantitative models for risk management, utilizing techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation and machine learning.
Model Validation: Conduct rigorous back-testing and validation of models, ensuring their robustness and alignment with regulation and market conditions.
Data Analysis & Interpretation: Analyze large datasets to identify trends, relationships, and patterns. Work with financial and market data to derive insights for model improvement and validation.
Process Optimization: Analyze process workflow and advise on improvements to facilitate experience in model application, maintenance, and internal and regulatory reporting.
Research & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest research in quantitative finance, machine learning, and statistical techniques. Apply new methodologies and tools to improve existing models and develop new strategies.


Let's Talk About You


You have a Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Business or Financial Engineering / Economics or Computer Science.
You have between 2 and 5 years of experience in quantitative modeling and/or validation, preferably in financial services, with hands-on experience with programming languages such as Python, R, Matlab or SAS/SQL.
You demonstrate understanding of business processes, regulatory requirements, internal control risk management, process, data and technology controls and related standards and frameworks.
You are fluent in English and Dutch or French.


Soft Skills


Quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills, with high capacity for solving challenging business problems
Present complex quantitative concepts and findings in a clear and accessible manner to stakeholders at various levels of technical expertise.
Strong analytical thinking and a drive for continuous learning and improvement, tech-savvy
Ability to work in a collaborative, team-based environment


How will you grow?


You will further develop your expertise across a broad range of quantitative applications in risk.
As you grow, you will be given more responsibility to manage assignments working directly with senior members of our client teams and guide junior colleagues.
As you become proficient in various skill sets, you will coach your colleagues and continue to enhance your management competencies.


Our story

Our Risk, Regulatory & Forensic practice is a global leader in helping clients manage risk and uncertainty from the boardroom to the network. We provide a broad array of services that allow our clients around the world to better measure, manage and control risk to enhance the reliability of systems and processes throughout their organization.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:


My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities


Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements remains essential in today's reality:


Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.


Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!
